work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper 0.1.0

- Initial release providing workflow support for Gog-style productivity needs on Clawhub.
- Helps users fix bugs, strengthen setups, increase safety, and create related workflows inspired by Google/Gog patterns.
- Includes a structured process: restate user goals, provide concise work plans or checklists, and validate outputs.
- Prioritizes local/hardware-friendly and repeatable solutions for practical productivity tasks.
- Triggered by common productivity and Google Workspace keywords or explicit workflow requests.
